title: npm run fast runs the standards test when a file named in standards evidence changes
body:
Why: on 2026-11-14 the refactor-clikit lane (t-5wzk8zf) moved text a standards record anchors (s-plainest-input) out of src/cli/lane.ts; npm run fast passed and the Check went red on test/brain/standards.test.ts.
Outcome: npm run fast selects test/brain/standards.test.ts when a changed or removed file is named in standards/records.json evidence.
Proof: test/fast-check.test.ts evidenceTests over the real records PASS; npm run fast PASS.
